description: Measure what check measured again, the same way, and compare with check's baseline. Returns Fixed (gone, and its animations still start and its values still move), Still there, New, Removed (gone because its animation or value stopped: not a fix), Not verifiable, the numbers before and after, and done: true or false with the reason. Call it after a change has reloaded in the app (Fast Refresh, hot reload or a rebuild).
name: recheck
